group-zj-2025-jan-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明文，围绕"如何更有效地沟通"给出若干建议。开篇指出沟通中最常见的错误是想表达太多，强调清晰简洁的重要性；随后以小标题加正文的形式列举多条实用技巧：心系听众、用词精简、让听众参与、选择合适的传递方式等，最后总结培养沟通能力虽费时但值得。七选五考查对小标题概括、段内衔接句以及转折/递进逻辑关系的把握。

discourseStructure.summary: 全文先提出问题与核心主张（清晰简洁），再分点给出沟通技巧，每个技巧多采用"小标题+解释"结构，结尾回扣主题进行总结。

units.summary: 引出话题：沟通中最常见的错误是想表达太多，最好的信息往往简单；并引出下文将给出的有效沟通技巧。

units.heading: Keep your audience in mind.
units.summary: 技巧一：心系听众，针对听众的兴趣量身定制沟通内容，直接谈他们关心的事，从而激发其理解与互动的愿望。

units.heading: Don’t use ten words when one will do.
units.summary: 技巧二：用词精简，保持信息简单清晰；提醒说话者虽对内容熟悉，但听众是第一次听到，故应保持简单。
技巧三：让听众参与，邀请其贡献想法、向他人讲解新概念、主持讨论，以教促学、提升沟通能力。

units.heading: Consider the best method to deliver your message.
units.summary: 技巧四：选择最佳传递方式，非紧急信息可用邮件，给听众更多时间审阅、思考、跟进，并留下可供回查的记录。
总结：培养有效沟通能力需要时间，但其效果值得付出努力。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: One of the most common mistakes in communication is trying to do too much.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: There’s no value in delivering any kind of communication, whether written, spoken, formal, or informal, if the message doesn’t come across clearly.

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中 simple 与空后 clear、brief 同属"简洁明了"话题场，承接前句对"想表达太多"这一错误的纠正。

mechanismSignals.targetText: The best messages are often simple
mechanismSignals.relation: 前句指出错误是"想表达太多"，与选项"最好的信息往往简单"形成问题—对策式衔接。
空后"清晰简洁"呼应选项 simple，证明本空主张正是简洁。

optionFit.fitSummary: 前句指出最常见的沟通错误是"想表达太多"，本空作为承上启下句给出正面主张——最好的信息往往简单，自然引出下文对"清晰简洁"的强调。

matchedClues.contextSide: trying to do too much / Being clear and brief
matchedClues.optionSide: The best messages are often simple
matchedClues.relation: "做太多"是错误，"简单"是对策，与前后文"清晰简洁才有价值"语义一致。

keyDistractors.reason: A"Be patient."是祈使句小标题式表达，与本段强调"简洁"的话题不符，且本空处于段中而非小标题位置。

q-zj-2025-jan-036.teachingNote: 段中过渡句要承接前句的"错误"并给出对应"对策"，抓住 too much 与 simple 的反义对照即可定位。

topicClues: tailor your communications to their interests

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Your audience will naturally be more interested and engaged when you tailor your communications to their interests.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: This will engage their desire to understand and interact with the information.

mechanismSignals.targetText: Speak directly to what matters to them
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 This 指代本空所述做法"直接谈听众关心的事"，构成代词回指衔接。
选项 to them 与前句 their interests、本段标题 your audience 中的听众指向一致。

mechanismSignals.signalText: tailor your communications to their interests
mechanismSignals.targetText: Speak directly to what matters to them
mechanismSignals.relation: 前句"按兴趣量身定制沟通"与选项"直接谈他们关心的事"是同义复述式衔接。

optionFit.fitSummary: 前句讲要按听众兴趣定制沟通，本空进一步具体化为"直接谈他们关心的事"，空后用 This 回指本空做法并说明其效果，前后衔接顺畅。

matchedClues.contextSide: tailor your communications to their interests / their desire to understand
matchedClues.optionSide: Speak directly to what matters to them
matchedClues.relation: "what matters to them"正是"their interests"的同义改写，且被空后 This 所回指。

keyDistractors.reason: B"Get the audience involved."是另一条技巧的小标题（对应39题），与本段"按兴趣定制"的主题不一致，且无法被空后 This 顺畅回指。

q-zj-2025-jan-037.teachingNote: 看空后代词 This 指什么，回填能被其回指、又与前句同义复述的句子即可锁定答案。

topicClues: Keeping your message simple and clear
hearing it for the first time

contextEvidence.headingAnchor: Don’t use ten words when one will do.
contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Keeping your message simple and clear will make it easier for people to understand.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: However, they’re hearing it for the first time. Keep it simple.

mechanismSignals.targetText: you already know what you’re going to say
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 However 引出转折，与本空"说话者已知道要说什么"形成"你已熟悉 vs 听众第一次听"的对比关系。

mechanismSignals.signalText: they’re hearing it for the first time
mechanismSignals.relation: However 连接的逻辑对象：空后"听众第一次听"与本空"你已知道"构成对照。
选项 the speaker 与本段 your message、Keep it simple 等沟通话题场一致，指向说话者视角。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后用 However 转折强调"听众是第一次听到"，故本空应给出与之对照的另一面——"作为说话者，你早已知道要说什么"，转折前后形成熟悉度的对比，引出"保持简单"的建议。

matchedClues.contextSide: However / they’re hearing it for the first time
matchedClues.optionSide: As the speaker, you already know what you’re going to say
matchedClues.relation: "你已知道"与"他们第一次听"经 However 构成对比，逻辑严密。

keyDistractors.reason: C"The best messages are often simple."虽与"简单"话题相关，但无法与空后 However 形成"说话者 vs 听众"的对比，逻辑不衔接（且已用于36题）。

q-zj-2025-jan-038.teachingNote: 见空后转折词 However，须在空内填入与其后内容相对立的一面，紧扣"已知/初闻"的对比即可。

topicClues: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas
take a role in explaining new concepts
Allow them to lead discussions and meetings
ways to learn new information than to teach it

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: If you’ve ever worked as an instructor, manager, trainer or coach, you’ll know that there are few better ways to learn new information than to teach it.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas or to take a role in explaining new concepts and policies to others.

mechanismSignals.targetText: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项"让听众参与"与下文"请听众贡献想法、主持讨论"为主题句与展开关系，audience 一词直接对应。

mechanismSignals.signalText: Allow them to lead discussions and meetings
mechanismSignals.relation: 下文"让他们主持讨论与会议"正是"参与"的具体体现，支撑本空为该段小标题。

mechanismSignals.signalText: to take a role in explaining
mechanismSignals.relation: "让听众扮演讲解角色"是"参与"的具体方式，与选项 involved 同属参与话题场。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本空为整段开头的小标题，下文反复说明要让听众贡献想法、扮演讲解角色、主持讨论会议，均是"让听众参与"的具体做法，故选 B 作总领。

matchedClues.contextSide: Ask the audience to contribute / Allow them to lead discussions
matchedClues.relation: 整段都在讲让 audience 参与，选项是对全段做法的概括小标题。

keyDistractors.reason: E"You may be surprised by what your listeners offer."虽与听众相关，但只是一句感想，无法概括"参与"这一整段做法，不适合作小标题。

q-zj-2025-jan-039.teachingNote: 独立成段的空多为小标题，需用一句祈使式短句概括全段反复出现的做法（此处为"让听众参与"）。

contextEvidence.headingAnchor: Consider the best method to deliver your message.
contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Written communication will give your audience more time to review it, think it over, and follow up with questions.

mechanismSignals.targetText: give your audience more time to review it
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中 also 表递进，承接前句书面沟通的第一项好处，再补充第二项好处（留存可回查的记录）。
选项句首 It 回指前句主语 Written communication，构成代词回指衔接。
前句"书面沟通会给…"与选项"它还会给他们…"句式平行，借 also 形成好处的并列递进。

optionFit.fitSummary: 前句说书面沟通给听众更多时间审阅、思考、跟进，本空作段末补充——它还能留下方便日后回查的记录，选项用 It 回指、also 递进，与前句句式平行衔接自然。

matchedClues.contextSide: Written communication will give your audience more time
matchedClues.optionSide: It will also give them a handy record to refer back to
matchedClues.relation: 前后均为"书面沟通带来的好处"，It 回指、also 递进，句式平行。

keyDistractors.reason: E"You may be surprised by what your listeners offer."与书面沟通的好处无关，既无 It 的回指对象衔接，也无递进逻辑，不合段末补充语境。

q-zj-2025-jan-040.teachingNote: 段末补充句常含 also/It 等递进与回指信号，回填能与前句句式平行、补充同类好处的选项即可。
